official_reference.note: Official reference used for magnitude comparison only.

interpretation: The archived operational GloFAS forecasts captured a very high river-discharge state at T-72, T-48 and T-24, but underestimated the NiHSA-reported peak magnitude by about 13-14 percent. This does not by itself prove a flood-warning threshold crossing or NaijaClimaGuard lead-time advantage; an independent decision threshold and complete replay are still required.
